methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series C → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.7x) to $31M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
TerraDepth is a Series C transportation company founded by Judson Kauffman and Josef Wolfel, having raised $31.1M to date. The Transportation sector peer universe includes 8 private companies—notably Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Slate Auto, and ZeroAvia—but no listed public comparables. The narrow peer set (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar-tier) contains fewer than three qualifying datapoints, limiting the applicability of median-peer valuation approaches.

A stage-progression method is the primary applicable framework here. Using total capital raised ($31.1M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to subsequent-stage progressions yields an implied valuation of $53M. This reflects the capital deployed and expected returns profile for a company at this funding stage within the Transportation sector.

Given the single-method constraint, the triangulated range spans $45M (low), $53M (median), and $61M (high). The median estimate of $53M serves as the central point estimate. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.7x stage multiplier for TerraDepth's specific risk and growth profile, and the absence of direct peer revenue or profitability data. A peer-median cross-check remains unavailable pending expansion of comparable transaction data within the Transportation frontier-tech cohort.
